name: Mitsumine Kaede
source: Classmate of the protagonist. Kaede is a refined and honorable lady who always follow the rules of etiquette and doesn't allow herself anything frivolous. Sometimes it's hard to understand, if she's completely indifferent to the love relationships or hides her feelings skillfully.
